ui_bugs.issue: In FR/ES, 'Texted back: “…”' (Logs rows + Inbox Missed calls) and 'You replied: “…”' (Inbox SMS item) stay in ENGLISH whenever the reply is not a preview (status sent/delivered/failed). The keys are 'Texted back: “{0}”{1}' / 'You replied: “{0}”{1}' and engine.js compile() turns every slot into ([\s\S]+?) which needs >=1 char, so an empty {1} (no ' (preview — not sent)' suffix) never matches. Preview replies translate fine ('Vous avez répondu : « … » (aperçu — non envoyé)'). This now hits every real (non-preview) text, i.e. all production texts.

smsDelivery uses an in-process 3 s setTimeout with unref — a backend restart within those 3 s loses the report (Telnyx already got 200). Acceptable but consider retry/queue.
Webhook payload with to[] of multiple recipients only reads to[0] — fine for 1:1 texts.

rca of the issue: i18n: engine.js compile() builds RegExp with ([\s\S]+?) per slot; key 'Texted back: “{0}”{1}' is rendered with {1}='' for non-preview replies -> regex requires >=1 char after the closing quote -> no match -> English shown.
